title: Unequal Verdicts: Investigating Gender Bias in LLM-Based Fake News Detection

bias_targets.methodology: Augmenting the LIAR dataset with gender-variant speaker job titles (Neutral, Male, and Female) for identical statements to measure whether LLM veracity judgments change based solely on the speaker's perceived gender, evaluated using flip rates, gender-cue sensitivity, and standard fairness metrics like Demographic Parity and Equalized Odds.
